special_awards: Best use of NVIDIA Nemotron (NVIDIA DGX Spark Founder's Edition)

cursor.how_used: Built in Cursor using Agent Mode (Composer for fast multi-file scaffolding of Zetaris SQL clients, interactive reasoning-tree visualizer, and tests; Grok for designing the speculative Tree-of-Hops search, innocent-account backtrack pruning math, FIFO taint-haircut conservation invariants, and Naive-vs-Markovian head-to-head benchmark). Guided by .cursor/rules/muletrace.mdc and AGENTS.md to enforce Zetaris single-statement SQL calls, optimistic World Model locking, bounded O(1) Markovian hop capsules, and Nightshift model receipts.

zetaris.how_used: Serves as the governed federated SQL data plane across real-time wire transfers, device/IP session telemetry, account KYC/payroll profiles, and crypto off-ramp order books, with single-statement REST execution, UUID4 X-Request-ID tracing, Lightning SQL source registration, and zero-setup SAMPLE_MODE virtualization.

meterless_engines.how_used: Core of the Track 3 Reasoning Architecture: Scout Intent classifies laundering typology and exit-countdown urgency; World Model maintains the live branching frontier, pruned safe branches, convergence hubs, and FIFO taint conservation with optimistic locking; Markovian compresses every hop into a fixed-size O(1) capsule (92.5% avg token reduction vs O(n^2) naive agent); H-MEM stores ring device/cadence signatures to shortcut repeat rings from 6 hops to 2 hops.

meterless_nightshift_and_nvidia_nemotron.how_used: Routes parallel hop-chaser scouts to Nemotron 30B for sub-second SQL exploration while routing dead-end innocence pruning, FIFO taint conservation verification, and surgical freeze synthesis to Nemotron 120B, recording a cryptographic ModelReceipt on every reasoning step.

pre_existing_components: None. All source code, reasoning architecture, Meterless Engine modules, Zetaris SQL schemas, benchmark datasets, tests, pitch deck, and motion-graphics video were built from scratch during the Open Agent Hackathon 2026 build window (22-27 October 2026).
